knowledge.title: What is a Genius Weft?
knowledge.body: Genius Weft is a continuous weft development format used in professional extension ranges. The photographed DS HAIR reference shows the general construction direction; seam profile, cut handling and installation performance must still be reviewed on the requested sample.

knowledge.title: How should a buyer choose length and weight?
knowledge.body: Length and gram weight should be selected around the intended service, natural-hair density, desired result and number of rows. A 50 g reference is useful for construction review, but it is not automatically a complete-head recommendation.

knowledge.title: Why use a physical colour reference?
knowledge.body: Hair colour changes with lighting, screens and fibre direction. Use Colour Chart 2 to shortlist shades, then approve a physical colour ring or product sample before production and repeat orders.

knowledge.title: How should textures be developed?
knowledge.body: Straight, Body Wave and curl patterns should be treated as separate approved references. Confirm pattern definition, finish, handling and care expectations on a sample instead of assuming one texture specification transfers to another.

knowledge.title: What should be fixed before quotation?
knowledge.body: Product construction, material direction, length, pack weight, colour reference, texture, packaging, estimated quantity and target market should be written into one brief. MOQ, price and lead time can then be quoted against the same document.

faqs: Can I order a Genius Weft sample before a wholesale programme?
Yes. Share the target market, preferred length, colour direction and evaluation goal. Sample availability, cost and timing are confirmed against the requested specification.
Can DS HAIR develop private-label packaging?
Label and packaging requirements can be reviewed as part of a B2B programme. Feasibility, minimum quantities and lead time are confirmed after the packaging brief.
Is every specification shown available for immediate order?
No. The page shows a 22-inch, 50-gram blonde reference. Final material, colour, length, pack format, MOQ, price and lead time must be confirmed in a written quotation.
Can I request Genius Weft from 16 to 28 inches or in a 100-gram pack?

You can include 16 to 28 inches and 50 or 100 grams in the buying brief. Only the 22-inch, 50-gram reference is currently documented on this page; all other combinations require written feasibility, sample and quotation confirmation.
How should I select a colour from DS HAIR Colour Chart 2?
Use the online chart to shortlist a colour code, then compare a physical colour ring or confirmed product sample under suitable lighting. Screen colour should not be treated as final approval.
Can Body Wave or Curly textures use the same specification as Straight hair?
No. Each texture should be treated as a separate development reference. Pattern definition, finish, handling and care expectations should be reviewed on the requested sample.

knowledge.title: What types of human hair clip-ins are available?
knowledge.body: The range can be developed as classic sewn-weft sets, seamless PU sets, one-piece volumizers or individual fill-in pieces. Each type serves a different wearer profile and coverage goal.

knowledge.title: Why is piece count not enough?
knowledge.body: Two seven-piece sets can behave very differently when their widths, clip counts, total grams and grams-by-piece are different. A repeatable product requires a written set map, not only 7 pcs/set on the package.

knowledge.title: How should weight be engineered?
knowledge.body: Start with the target wearer and desired result, then set total hair grams and distribute them across the wefts. The same total weight can feel and blend differently depending on where the grams sit in the set.

knowledge.title: How do classic and seamless clip-ins differ?
knowledge.body: Classic clip-ins use a sewn or fabric weft with a more structured top. Seamless clip-ins use a thinner PU-style top designed for a flatter root profile. The correct choice depends on wearer density, target result and sample approval.

knowledge.title: What controls a reliable reorder?
knowledge.body: Keep one approved sample and one written specification covering the set map, grams by piece, PU construction, hair details, colour reference, clip hardware, tolerances, packaging and QC checkpoints.

faqs: Do Clip-In Hair Extensions have a product code?

No. This product family is identified by its product name and confirmed specification: classic, seamless, one-piece or single clip-in, followed by the set map, length, weight distribution, colour and packaging.
Can I request a 7-piece or 8-piece sample?
Yes. Share the preferred format, length, target total weight, construction and colour direction. Sample feasibility, cost and timing are confirmed against that brief.
Does 7 pcs/set or 8 pcs/set define the full product?
No. The full specification also needs the construction, each piece width, clip layout, total hair weight, grams by piece, length, texture, colour reference and repeat-order tolerances.
Can DS HAIR develop a single clip-in piece?
A single-piece request can be reviewed. State the intended placement, width, clip count, target weight, length and colour so the construction can be evaluated.
Are all lengths and weights shown ready to order?
No. They are buying-request options for preparing a brief. A length and gram value is not confirmed until it is tied to the chosen product type, set map, hair specification and written quotation.
Can I request private-label packaging?
Yes. Label, backing card, storage and retail-pack requirements can be reviewed with the product brief. Feasibility and minimum quantities are confirmed separately.

knowledge.body: It is a pre-shaped synthetic updo that attaches over the wearer's own bun or gathered hair. This reference uses a contoured claw clip to create a fast, softly looped chignon silhouette.

knowledge.title: What should wholesale buyers check on the claw clip?
knowledge.body: Review opening force, tooth edges, spring recovery, contour, base colour, comfort and holding performance. The fibre should cover the hardware in the intended wearing positions.

knowledge.title: How should the synthetic fibre be specified?
knowledge.body: Record fibre family, diameter, shine, hand, wave memory, heat-care claim and test method. Heat resistance must never be inferred from appearance or a generic synthetic description.

knowledge.title: How is chignon colour matching approved?
knowledge.body: Use a physical shade reference under neutral light and record base, highlight and lowlight ratios. Multi-tonal blends often integrate more naturally than a single screen-selected colour.

knowledge.title: What supports a reliable private-label reorder?
